evals.prompt: Using the supplied open and frozen prior RFC fixtures plus the last-synced marker, classify three re-sync outcomes: an Open RFC with a changed and a new candidate; a Frozen RFC with an operator-flagged verdict typo; and a Frozen RFC with new candidates or reversed verdicts.
evals.expected_output: The Open RFC receives an in-place Amendment. The Frozen RFC's operator-flagged typo receives an additive Erratum only after Approver sign-off. Frozen new candidates or reversed verdicts require a new RFC, followed by an Approver-signed Erratum on the prior RFC naming the superseder. Unchanged hashes are skipped, and fresh decisions are never appended to a Frozen RFC's Errata.
assertions: Routes the Open-RFC delta to an in-place Amendment
Treats a Frozen-RFC correction as operator-flagged and requires Approver sign-off before an Erratum
Routes Frozen new or reversed decisions to a new RFC
Records the superseder on the prior RFC only after Approver sign-off
Skips unchanged hashes and never appends fresh decisions to Frozen Errata
